newsitem.title: USA: Lloyd's of London and state of Missouri sign pact.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's of London and state of Missouri sign pact.

text.p: Lloyd's of London said on Wednesday that it signed an agreement with the state of Missouri that resolves all claims and disputes arising from the participation of Missouri Names in the Lloyd's insurance market.

The company said the agreement extends to the state the benefits of an accord between Lloyd's and the Coordinating Committee of the North American Securities Administrators Association earlier this year.
The agreement, which now covers 47 states and the District of Columbia, leaves Arizona as the only non-signatory state where Names are residents.
The company said more than three quarters of the total U.S. Names have accepted the $5 billion Lloyd's settlement offer.
